text:
Noah: Alright team, lunch thief strikes again. Someone took my labeled container (BIG red Tupperware, 'NO STEAL - NOAH'). :cry:
Ivy: Oh no. Evidence? last seen in the fridge at 12:03. Any suspects? :mag_right:
Liam: I confess nothing but I did hear suspicious fork clinking near the yogurt shelf. :eyes:
Zoe: We should form a temporary detective club. Name ideas: "Fridge Patrol", "Leftover League", "Cold Case Committee". :detective:
Noah: Vote: Detective club or passive-aggressive Slack note? 1) Club 2) Note 3) Fridge stakeout
Ivy: Club. Also we need a code of honor: return containers, label loudly, do not microwave other people's lunch without permission.
Liam: Proposal: "If you take someone's food by mistake, you owe them a coffee + one dramatic apology GIF." Fair?
Zoe: Love it. Also adding a low-effort ritual: thief must wear a neon sticky-note sash that says "I stole a lunch" at the next all-hands (or send a theatrical apology video).
FridgeBot: Log entry created: "Noah's red Tupperware reported missing" at 12:05. Reminder scheduled: "Fridge Patrol stakeout" tomorrow 12:00. (Automated by FridgeBot)
Noah: OK Detective club formed. First rule — label with name + emoji. I'll bring an extra set of stickers tomorrow. Who's on stakeout? Liam and Zoe volunteered. :flashlight:
Liam: I'll stakeout but only if I can bring snacks to bait the thief. :cookie:
Zoe: Deal. Also can we add a tiny 'Lost Lunch' poster near the fridge with a tasteful sketch? Low-effort, high shame.
Ivy: Poster maker volunteer: me. I'll mock up something silly.
Noah: Love it. If culprit confesses, coffee and sticker sash for redemption. Case accepted. :mortar_board:
